title: Ottawa convoy rally / occupation beyond the Jan. 29 crowd
location: Parliament Hill and central Ottawa, Ontario
participants_original: Jan. 29 CP report confirms crowds but gives no realized count; official estimates in S041/S049 are search-only.
notes: S021 search-only committee timeline labels broader protest Jan. 28–Feb. 20; S040 says trucks arrived Jan. 28 and protest continued into the first weekend. This file directly confirms humans on Jan. 29. Neither vehicle arrival nor broad timeline establishes human onset/end. February review should resolve continuity/physical ending without retroactively dating a Jan. 28 crowd.

start_date.summary: Opened CP report confirms Jan. 29 human crowds; S040 describes Jan. 28 vehicles without a human count.

continuity.summary: Search-only timeline and inquiry overview indicate activity continued into February; exact physical end is unknown.

open_questions: Were people assembled Jan. 28 in a distinct human gathering?
Did the Jan. 29 gathering continue as one occupation through February?
What is the physical end of the human assembly?

title: Coutts border blockade beyond Jan. 29
location: Coutts / Alberta port of entry, Alberta
participants_original: CBSA search-result excerpt estimates 500–700 demonstrators in a Jan. 30 update; not a Jan. 29 count.
notes: Committee search result gives Jan. 29–Feb. 15 as the Coutts blockade timeline. Retain unresolved follow-up to February; the timeline endpoint may describe the blockade, not exact crowd presence/dispersal. This is distinct from Emerson Jan. 17 and moving convoy vehicles.

start_date.summary: Search-only committee timeline dates blockade start Jan. 29; body and first-day attendance remain unverified.

continuity.summary: Search-only CBSA update reports 500–700 by Jan. 30; timeline labels blockade through Feb. 15.

open_questions: Verify first-day human attendance and demand.
Distinguish continuous blockade from changing gatherings/vehicles.
Establish physical ending and event-specific state response.
